# sently

> Runtime-agnostic email library for Node.js, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers. v0.6.2

## What it does
Sends emails via SMTP or HTTP APIs (Resend, SendGrid, Postmark, Mailgun, AWS SES, Brevo).
Zero runtime dependencies in core. HTTP stacks ~6 KB gzip (`sently/mailer` + transport); SMTP via `sently/smtp` ~15 KB. Full TypeScript support.

Features: single send, `sendBulk` (native batch on Resend/SendGrid), idempotency decorator, webhook event parsers, optional React Email plugin, DKIM, OAuth2 SMTP, connection pool + rate limiting.

## When to use sently
- You need to send email from Bun, Deno, or Cloudflare Workers
- You want to replace Nodemailer with an ESM-native library
- You need DKIM signing without external dependencies
- You want to swap email providers without changing send code
- You need delivery webhooks normalized across providers

## When NOT to use sently
- You need SOCKS proxy support
- You need iCal/calendar attachments
- You require CommonJS

## Install
bun add sently

Optional peers (only if using React Email): `react`, `@react-email/render`

## Quick example (HTTP — smallest bundle)
import { createMailer } from "sently/mailer"
import { ResendTransport } from "sently/transports/resend"

const mailer = await createMailer({
  transport: new ResendTransport({ apiKey: process.env.RESEND_API_KEY }),
})
await mailer.send({ from, to, subject, html })

## Quick example (SMTP)
import { createMailer } from "sently/smtp"

const mailer = await createMailer({
  host: "smtp.example.com",
  port: 587,
  auth: { user: "you@example.com", pass: "secret" },
})
await mailer.send({ from, to, subject, text: "Hello" })

## Quick example (batch)
const result = await mailer.sendBulk(messages, {
  rateDelta: 2,       // batch HTTP requests per second (Resend default)
  rateLimit: 1000,
  onError: (msg, i, err) => console.error(i, err),
})

## Quick example (idempotency — wrap outside RetryTransport)
import { IdempotencyTransport } from "sently/idempotency"
import { RetryTransport } from "sently/transports/retry"

const transport = new IdempotencyTransport(
  new RetryTransport(new ResendTransport({ apiKey })),
)

## Quick example (webhooks)
import { parseResendWebhook, verifyResendSignature } from "sently/webhooks"

const events = parseResendWebhook(await request.json())

## Quick example (React Email — sently/react only, not main barrel)
import { reactPlugin } from "sently/react"

const mailer = await createMailer({
  transport: new ResendTransport({ apiKey }),
  plugins: [reactPlugin()],
})

## Breaking (v0.6.2)
- Main `createMailer` from `"sently"` is transport-only (~2.4 KB gzip). SMTP relay: `"sently/smtp"` or `createSMTPMailer` from `"sently"`.

## Breaking (v0.5.1)
- `reactPlugin` and `ReactMailOptions` are NOT exported from `"sently"`. Use `"sently/react"`.

## Subpath exports
- sently — transport `createMailer`, `createSMTPMailer`, types, OAuth2 (~2.4 KB main createMailer). Does NOT export react plugin.
- sently/mailer — createMailer for custom transports (~2.4 KB); sendBulk, plugins
- sently/smtp — SMTP createMailer (host/port, pool, adapters, ~15 KB)
- sently/dkim — DKIM signing (lazy-loaded when dkim option set)
- sently/react — reactPlugin, ReactMailOptions (optional peers)
- sently/idempotency — IdempotencyTransport, MemoryIdempotencyStore
- sently/webhooks — parse*Webhook, verifyResendSignature, verifyMailgunSignature, EmailEvent
- sently/errors — SentlyError, stable error codes
- sently/transports/resend — ResendTransport, RESEND_BATCH_MAX
- sently/transports/sendgrid — SendGridTransport
- sently/transports/postmark — PostmarkTransport
- sently/transports/mailgun — MailgunTransport
- sently/transports/ses — SESTransport
- sently/transports/brevo — BrevoTransport
- sently/transports/smtp — SMTPTransport
- sently/transports/retry — RetryTransport
- sently/transports/preview — PreviewTransport
- sently/adapters/node — NodeAdapter
- sently/adapters/bun — BunAdapter
- sently/adapters/deno — DenoAdapter
- sently/adapters/cf — CloudflareAdapter
- sently/auth/oauth2 — OAuth2Client
- sently/pool — SMTPPool (rate limiting via rateDelta/rateLimit)
- sently/plugins/template — templatePlugin, simpleEngine

## SendResult optional fields
- deduped?: true — idempotency cache hit (absent on normal sends)
- batchError?: unknown — per-message failure inside a successful batch response
